Asset reference and first-batch integrity checks passed. Syntax and git diff checks passed.
No rendered browser, touch-emulation, screenshot or enjoyment evidence for this prototype yet.

candidates.title: Moon Dial
candidates.coreLoop: Rotate coupled dials while shifting a single clutch to isolate connected components and align every hand to its target.
tests: 7 engine tests pass, including all original solutions/saves, optional shortest-action guidance, nonmutation and recovery from 24 legal detours across three mechanisms.
6 DOM tests pass, including prior control/save regressions, optional guidance, hint clearing after moves, paused/won handling, unreadable-save preservation and full-journal explanation.
JavaScript syntax checks passed. No rendered browser, screenshot, touch or enjoyment evidence. Full repository build was not run from the partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three compact mechanisms; solutions use 3, 6 and 11 total actions. Unlimited undo; no failure condition. No long-play claim.

nextSteps: Play actual rendered loop; inspect readability of coupled motion and touch selection.
Implement a substantive playtest-led improvement, then verify desktop/touch, progression, undo/retry, save/reload, reset and navigation before integration.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Code and DOM inspection; not rendered playtesting.
changes: Save selected dial immediately; migrate old saves to dial A and validate selection bounds.
Keep dial/hand DOM elements across updates to preserve focus and permit existing CSS transitions.
Use accumulated rotation so 5-to-0 and undo move one tooth rather than almost a full revolution.
Label moving/isolated dials and restore coupling-button focus after redraws.
pendingSourceRefinement.remaining: Rendered desktop/touch gameplay, animation/readability review and a substantive playtest-led improvement. This repair is not counted as completed improvement.

pendingGuidance.basis: Source inspection: players had no recovery guidance after getting lost in gear coupling. Not a rendered observation.
pendingGuidance.before: Only restart or manual trial and error could help a stuck player.
pendingGuidance.after: Optional next-step guidance searches the current mechanism, explains one action and route length, never moves gears or changes the save, and clears after a move.
pendingGuidance.verification: 13 engine/DOM tests pass. Rendered gameplay/readability/touch review still required; no improvement-pass credit.

candidates.title: Pebble Rink
candidates.coreLoop: Aim, weight and curl three stones; use friction, banks and collisions to leave stones in scoring rings.
tests: 7 engine tests pass: all three rink wins/unlocks and exact saves, opposite curl, collisions/bounds, film endpoints, loss/undo/retry, malformed saves, read-only review and precise undo setup recall.

7 DOM tests pass: all rink routes/reloads, pause/resume, loss/retry/reset/recovery, elapsed-time playback at different callback rates, read-only replay, per-stone scoring notes, native focused-control keys and help cancellation. Canvas and animation timestamps are mocked.

Syntax, local asset references and exact fifty-slot/count checks passed. Remote change comparison confirms only Pebble Rink source/tests and its development documentation changed. Full repository build/preservation suite not run from partial checkout.
No rendered, screenshot, physical-touch or enjoyment evidence. Not selected.

quality.knownLimits: Three compact rinks with finite three-stone ends. No rendered/touch or human enjoyment evidence. Physics tuning and readability need review.

nextSteps: Play rendered aiming, curl and collision loops on desktop/touch; inspect screenshots and tune mechanics from observed weaknesses.
Complete a substantive improvement pass and verify progression/loss/retry, saves/reload, reset and real navigation before catalogue integration.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source inspection and reproduced engine/DOM behavior, not rendered playtesting.
changes: Replace one-frame-per-callback animation with elapsed-time playback; paused dialogs/tabs do not accumulate catch-up time.
Keep native Space/arrow behavior on focused controls and navigation; focusable rink accepts gameplay shortcuts.
Replay the previous shot and its collisions without changing the shot journal, records or save; show each stone's points before and after the shot.
Undo recalls the removed shot's angle, weight and curl and restores previous stone positions, allowing targeted adjustment.
Refresh disabled controls after native guide cancellation and preserve rink-selection focus.

candidates.title: Pocket Regatta
candidates.coreLoop: Tack a small sailboat around ordered buoys using wind direction, limited helm turns and short/full sail while avoiding grounding.
tests: 7 engine tests pass: original course solutions/unlocks/saves, wind/helm limits, intermediate buoy crossing, collision/loss/undo/retry, malformed saves, projection equivalence/nonmutation and later-leg validity.

6 DOM tests pass: original course/save/control regressions; drafting and executing all three routes one tack at a time; trim/clear, pause, cancel, reload, future-heading/grounding warnings and clearing stale drafts after undo.
Syntax and catalogue exclusion checks passed. No rendered browser, screenshot, touch or human enjoyment evidence. Full repository build not run from partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three compact fixed-wind courses, solved in 10/9/12 moves by automated search. Unlimited undo; no content-hours claim. Course readability, touch comfort and longer-term depth require rendered assessment.

nextSteps: Play actual rendered tacking and sail-size decisions on desktop/touch; inspect chart/preview screenshots.
Use observed weakness for a substantive improvement pass; verify progression, grounding/retry, save/reload, restart and real navigation before integration.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source inspection showed only the immediate tack could be previewed. Not a rendered-play observation.
pendingSourceRefinement.before: Players had to execute a tack before checking the next turn limit, reef approach or buoy crossing.
pendingSourceRefinement.after: An editable draft of up to six tacks projects successive headings, paths, hull and buoys without spending moves. A separate action sails the first tack only; the remainder stays editable. Drafts do not alter saved progress and are explicitly temporary.
pendingSourceRefinement.testing: 13 engine/DOM checks passed. No completed improvement credit until actual rendered playtesting, screenshots and game-specific quality assessment.

candidates.title: Crate & Cushion
candidates.coreLoop: Rotate and fit parcels around tray braces, cushion a telescope along shared edges and keep the heavy toolbox away before sealing.
tests: 8 engine tests pass: original pack/seal/unlock/save checks, fit/contact rules, undo/repack, corruption rejection, all three achievable care goals, award timing/persistence, legacy save migration and nonmutating protection forecasts.
5 DOM tests pass: original control/reload/recovery checks plus care-goal feedback, prospective protection, award reload and selecting packed parcels without moving them.
Syntax and catalogue exclusion pass. No rendered browser, screenshot, touch or enjoyment evidence; full repository build not run from partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three small four-parcel jobs. Automated solutions use four placements plus sealing. No loss condition; undo/repacking is unrestricted within journal bounds. Difficulty and replay depth require rendered playtesting.

nextSteps: Play actual rendered packing loop and inspect desktop/touch previews, controls and occupied-cell readability.
Identify the primary enjoyment/depth weakness and implement a substantial improvement, then verify saves/reload, undo/repack, restart and real navigation before selection.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source inspection and automated packing search, not rendered playtesting.
pendingSourceRefinement.before: Only normal dispatch and move-count records; protection feedback appeared after placement. Reselecting a parcel recalled rotation but not its position.
pendingSourceRefinement.after: Optional job-specific care seals reward extra blanket/foam protection while retaining normal dispatch. Pre-placement feedback shows resulting contacts and readiness. Reselecting packed parcels recalls anchor and rotation. Old saves migrate without invented care awards.
pendingSourceRefinement.testing: 13 engine/DOM checks passed. All three optional goals have valid packing solutions. Rendered review and substantive playtest-led improvement still required; no completed improvement credit.

candidates.title: Bramble Dice
candidates.coreLoop: Keep or reroll four dice, allocate every die to attack, guard or repair against visible enemy intents, then choose stacking equipment between woodland encounters.

Script syntax passed. No rendered browser, screenshots, touch or human-enjoyment evidence. Full repository build not run from partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three authored encounters with changing intent cycles. Automated winning routes take 6–10 turns for the sampled seeds/equipment; dice-seed variation is not additional authored content. No playtime or enjoyment claim.

nextSteps: Play the actual rendered loop on desktop and touch; assess dice pinning, exact forecast readability, equipment tradeoffs and progression depth.
Implement a substantive improvement based on observed play, verify natural progression/loss/retry/saves/restart/navigation and inspect screenshots before integration.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source inspection and engine/DOM behavior, not rendered playtesting.

pendingSourceRefinement.remaining: Rendered play, balance/readability review, meaningful playtest-led improvement and all public integration gates remain outstanding. No completed improvement credit.

candidates.title: Needlepath

tests: 11 engine tests pass, including all 31 initial winning routes and advisory correctness against independent winning-route fixtures at all 1,262 reachable action prefixes. Search cutoff reports unknown conservatively; advice preserves state and save format.

7 jsdom 26.1.0 tests pass, including guide opt-in/hide/reload, target highlights, knot advice, early blocked-branch explanation, campaign, saves, resets and pause/dialog/bridge guards. Dialog methods are simulated.
Both gameplay scripts pass syntax checks. No rendered/browser, screenshot, native keyboard activation, touch or human-enjoyment evidence. Full repository checks not run from partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three compact authored samplers. Exhaustive engine checks find 31 finishing action sequences, not 31 authored levels. Fewest-thread goals are attainable at 12/14/18; optimization and knot tradeoffs remain unassessed for human enjoyment. No content-duration claim.

nextSteps: Play the actual rendered core loop on desktop and touch; inspect thread faces, optional pins, flower endpoints and pass-over-pin readability.
Implement a substantive improvement from observed rendered play; verify progression, dead ends/retry, saves/reload, restart, navigation and screenshots before integration.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source and engine inspection, not rendered playtesting.
pendingSourceRefinement.before: Immediate legal-stitch highlights did not tell players whether a completion remained; a locally legal branch could be doomed without an explanation until later.
pendingSourceRefinement.after: An optional read-only thread guide suggests one next move toward the least-thread completion, forecasts remaining/total thread and ribbon, and explains when undo is required. Knot advice is included. No auto-play, thread cost or save-format change.
pendingSourceRefinement.remaining: Rendered desktop/touch play, screenshot inspection and a substantive playtest-led improvement remain required.

candidates.title: Reedbreaker
candidates.coreLoop: Walk to recover energy, bait deterministic clockwork beetles near water, then dash up to three squares to shove one off the bank while managing enemy responses and shield.
tests: 9 engine tests pass: all original routes and saves, three hook-assisted routes with exact forecasts/reloads, hook energy/retreat constraints, other-beetle retaliation, loss/retry, records and malformed saves.

6 jsdom 26.1.0 tests pass: original and hook campaigns, button/H-key selection, previews, reload, pause/confirmation/bridge guards, reset isolation, unreadable recovery and quota failures. Dialogs simulated.
Both gameplay scripts pass syntax checks. No rendered/browser, screenshot, actual touch/native keyboard activation or human-enjoyment evidence. Full repository checks not run from partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three compact authored banks with two beetles each. Automated winning routes take 8/5/6 turns and retain 6/5/5 shield. This demonstrates playability, not enjoyment or substantial content duration. Depth, balance and visual readability require rendered playtesting.

nextSteps: Play each bank naturally in a rendered desktop/touch browser; inspect movement, shove feedback, enemy priorities and whole-turn previews.
Implement a substantive improvement based on observed play, verify progression/loss/retry/saves/restart/navigation and screenshots before catalogue selection.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source/engine inspection; rendered playtesting remains blocked.
pendingSourceRefinement.before: Only walking and forward dash shoves were possible. Players could not directly draw beetles away from an obstacle.
pendingSourceRefinement.after: Hook costs one energy to pull an adjacent beetle into the ranger's old square while retreating one square onto free land. Only the hooked beetle skips its response. The choice competes with saving two energy for dashing; whole-turn forecasts include all responses.
pendingSourceRefinement.remaining: Rendered desktop/touch play, screenshot inspection, balance/clarity assessment and substantive playtest-led improvement remain required.

candidates.title: Beepline
candidates.coreLoop: Compose a short repeating flight program with forward, glide, turn and conditional Scout commands; debug its route to collect flowers and return to the hive, then optimize command count.
tests: 8 engine tests pass: original sequential three-garden wins and save/reload, all 5,460 legacy programs per garden unchanged (minima 3/2/5), new Scout branches/routes, all 19,530 extended programs per garden (minima 3/1/3), backward inspection at every cursor with records preserved, and malformed/legacy save validation.

7 jsdom 26.1.0 tests pass: original UI campaign, Scout UI routes through every garden, backward inspection/reload, Run/Stop/pause/dialog/parent guards, crash/loop retry, Space/form controls, reset isolation, corrupt-save recovery and quota failure. Dialogs and intervals simulated.

Both gameplay scripts pass syntax checks. No rendered play, screenshots, native keyboard activation, touch/mobile layout or human-enjoyment evidence. Full repository checks not run from partial checkout.

quality.knownLimits: Three compact authored gardens. Extended-program minima are 3/1/3; original command minima stay 3/2/5. Scout simplifies Hedge run to one command, requiring natural-play balance assessment. Enumeration is verification, not extra levels or content hours. Visual/debugging clarity and enjoyment remain unassessed.

nextSteps: Play all three gardens naturally in a rendered browser on desktop/touch; inspect Scout branch feedback, backward inspection, glide highlighting, focus and loop explanations.
Assess whether conditional programming leaves adequate puzzle depth, especially Hedge run; make and verify a substantive playtest-led improvement before catalogue selection.

pendingSourceRefinement.basis: Source/engine/DOM inspection; rendered playtesting remains blocked.
pendingSourceRefinement.before: Flight programs had only fixed forward/glide/turn actions. Playback could only advance or restart, making failed routes harder to inspect.
pendingSourceRefinement.after: Scout moves one square if clear or turns right at a hedge, deciding afresh on each execution. Back one step retraces any flight, including crash/loop/win endpoints, without removing earned records; it stops autoplay and respects pause/confirmation guards.
pendingSourceRefinement.remaining: Render natural desktop/touch play, inspect screenshots and assess conditional-command clarity and puzzle balance (especially the now one-command Hedge run); a substantive playtest-led improvement remains required.
